title: 微影晶圓台精密定位
titleEn: Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages
summary: 以步進掃描微影機的雙台晶圓台為對象：先建立光罩台與晶圓台 4:1 同步掃描的 MA/MSD 誤差定義與 Abbe 原理，再拆解長短行程 Lorentz 致動器與平衡質量、雷射干涉儀與二維光柵編碼器的解析度與空氣折射率限制，接著以伺服頻寬、前饋精度、校正圖與隔振傳遞率建立奈米級誤差預算，最後整合成產能與套刻驗收記錄。
summaryEn: Taking the dual wafer stage of a step-and-scan lithography system as the object, the course first defines the MA/MSD errors of 4:1 synchronised reticle and wafer scanning and the Abbe principle, then dissects long- and short-stroke Lorentz actuators with balance masses, the resolution and air-index limits of laser interferometers and two-dimensional grating encoders, builds a nanometre error budget from servo bandwidth, feedforward accuracy, calibration maps and isolation transmissibility, and closes with a throughput and overlay acceptance record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「步進掃描的同步誤差定義」與「Abbe 原理與計量框架」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan" and "The Abbe principle and the metrology frame": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 步進掃描的同步誤差定義：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」如何決定微影晶圓台精密定位的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning” determines the key performance of “Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 步進掃描機以一條約 26 mm 寬、數毫米高的照明縫隙掃過光罩，光罩台與晶圓台必須以 4:1 的速度比反向同步運動，掃完一個 26×33 mm 的場後晶圓台步進到下一場。晶圓上任一點在縫隙通過期間累積曝光，所以位置誤差的影響分成兩類：這段時間的平均誤差（MA）直接變成套刻誤差，而誤差的移動標準差（MSD）讓影像模糊、降低對比與 CD 均勻性。因此規格不是單一的定位精度，而是對掃描時間窗平均後的 MA 與 MSD。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A step-and-scan system sweeps an illumination slit roughly 26 mm wide and a few millimetres high across the reticle while the reticle stage and wafer stage move in opposite directions at a 4:1 speed ratio, and after each 26×33 mm field the wafer stage steps to the next one. Any wafer point accumulates exposure while the slit passes, so position error acts in two ways: its average over that window (MA) becomes overlay error, while its moving standard deviation (MSD) blurs the image and degrades contrast and CD uniformity. The specification is therefore not a single positioning accuracy but MA and MSD averaged over the scan time window. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s 時光罩台為 2.0 m/s；掃描長度 33 mm 加縫隙高 8 mm 共 41 mm，需時 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms；以 20 m/s² 加速到 0.5 m/s 需 25 ms 與 v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm 的助跑距離；晶圓上每一點在 8 mm 縫隙下停留 16 ms，MA 與 MSD 就是在這 16 ms 窗口內計算。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s the reticle stage runs at 2.0 m/s; the 33 mm scan plus an 8 mm slit height is 41 mm and takes 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms; accelerating to 0.5 m/s at 20 m/s² takes 25 ms and a run-up distance of v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm; every wafer point sits under the 8 mm slit for 16 ms, and MA and MSD are computed over that 16 ms window.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「晶圓台的靜態定位精度就等於套刻精度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The static positioning accuracy of the stage equals the overlay accuracy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 步進掃描的同步誤差定義
knowledge.text: 步進掃描機以一條約 26 mm 寬、數毫米高的照明縫隙掃過光罩，光罩台與晶圓台必須以 4:1 的速度比反向同步運動，掃完一個 26×33 mm 的場後晶圓台步進到下一場。晶圓上任一點在縫隙通過期間累積曝光，所以位置誤差的影響分成兩類：這段時間的平均誤差（MA）直接變成套刻誤差，而誤差的移動標準差（MSD）讓影像模糊、降低對比與 CD 均勻性。
knowledge.textEn: A step-and-scan system sweeps an illumination slit roughly 26 mm wide and a few millimetres high across the reticle while the reticle stage and wafer stage move in opposite directions at a 4:1 speed ratio, and after each 26×33 mm field the wafer stage steps to the next one. Any wafer point accumulates exposure while the slit passes, so position error acts in two ways: its average over that window (MA) becomes overlay error, while its moving standard deviation (MSD) blurs the image and degrades contrast and CD uniformity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：晶圓台的靜態定位精度就等於套刻精度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The static positioning accuracy of the stage equals the overlay accuracy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「微影晶圓台精密定位」的「步進掃描的同步誤差定義：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「光學工作台：焦點失蹤」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan: mechanism and system boundary” in “Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Optical Bench: Missing Focus” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「步進掃描的同步誤差定義」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan" is correct?
options: 晶圓台的靜態定位精度就等於套刻精度。
步進掃描機以一條約 26 mm 寬、數毫米高的照明縫隙掃過光罩，光罩台與晶圓台必須以 4:1 的速度比反向同步運動，掃完一個 26×33 mm 的場後晶圓台步進到下一場。
只要載台導軌夠直，旋轉誤差就可以忽略。
optionsEn: The static positioning accuracy of the stage equals the overlay accuracy.

A step-and-scan system sweeps an illumination slit roughly 26 mm wide and a few millimetres high across the reticle while the reticle stage and wafer stage move in opposite directions at a 4:1 speed ratio, and after each 26×33 mm field the wafer stage steps to the next one.
With straight enough guideways, rotation errors can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 步進掃描機以一條約 26 mm 寬、數毫米高的照明縫隙掃過光罩，光罩台與晶圓台必須以 4:1 的速度比反向同步運動，掃完一個 26×33 mm 的場後晶圓台步進到下一場。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A step-and-scan system sweeps an illumination slit roughly 26 mm wide and a few millimetres high across the reticle while the reticle stage and wafer stage move in opposite directions at a 4:1 speed ratio, and after each 26×33 mm field the wafer stage steps to the next one. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 步進掃描的同步誤差定義：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s 時光罩台為 2.0 m/s；掃描長度 33 mm 加縫隙高 8 mm 共 41 mm，需時 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms；以 20 m/s² 加速到 0.5 m/s 需 25 ms 與 v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm 的助跑距離；晶圓上每一點在 8 mm 縫隙下停留 16 ms，MA 與 MSD 就是在這 16 ms 窗口內計算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s the reticle stage runs at 2.0 m/s; the 33 mm scan plus an 8 mm slit height is 41 mm and takes 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms; accelerating to 0.5 m/s at 20 m/s² takes 25 ms and a run-up distance of v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm; every wafer point sits under the 8 mm slit for 16 ms, and MA and MSD are computed over that 16 ms window. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從伺服系統以取樣率數十 kHz 記錄光罩台與晶圓台的位置誤差，先換算成晶圓座標（光罩誤差除以 4），對 16 ms 的滑動窗口計算 MA 與 MSD，沿掃描方向畫成曲線，再與曝光後的套刻與 CD 量測對應，確認兩者的空間分佈一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log reticle- and wafer-stage position errors from the servo at tens of kHz, convert them to wafer coordinates (reticle error divided by 4), compute MA and MSD over a sliding 16 ms window, plot them along the scan direction and correlate with post-exposure overlay and CD measurements to confirm matching spatial patterns.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s 時光罩台為 2.0 m/s；掃描長度 33 mm 加縫隙高 8 mm 共 41 mm，需時 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms；以 20 m/s² 加速到 0.5 m/s 需 25 ms 與 v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm 的助跑距離；晶圓上每一點在 8 mm 縫隙下停留 16 ms，MA 與 MSD 就是在這 16 ms 窗口內計算。
knowledge.textEn: At a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s the reticle stage runs at 2.0 m/s; the 33 mm scan plus an 8 mm slit height is 41 mm and takes 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms; accelerating to 0.5 m/s at 20 m/s² takes 25 ms and a run-up distance of v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm; every wafer point sits under the 8 mm slit for 16 ms, and MA and MSD are computed over that 16 ms window.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「步進掃描的同步誤差定義」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan", which statement holds?
options: 干涉儀的解析度 0.04 nm 就是它的量測精度。
一次出廠校正就能讓校正圖永久有效。
晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s 時光罩台為 2.0 m/s。
optionsEn: An interferometer with 0.04 nm resolution measures with 0.04 nm accuracy.
A single factory calibration keeps the calibration map valid forever.
At a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s the reticle stage runs at 2.0 m/s.
quiz.explanation: 晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s 時光罩台為 2.0 m/s；掃描長度 33 mm 加縫隙高 8 mm 共 41 mm，需時 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms；以 20 m/s² 加速到 0.5 m/s 需 25 ms 與 v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm 的助跑距離；晶圓上每一點在 8 mm 縫隙下停留 16 ms，MA 與 MSD 就是在這 16 ms 窗口內計算。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s the reticle stage runs at 2.0 m/s; the 33 mm scan plus an 8 mm slit height is 41 mm and takes 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms; accelerating to 0.5 m/s at 20 m/s² takes 25 ms and a run-up distance of v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm; every wafer point sits under the 8 mm slit for 16 ms, and MA and MSD are computed over that 16 ms window. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 步進掃描的同步誤差定義：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 從伺服系統以取樣率數十 kHz 記錄光罩台與晶圓台的位置誤差，先換算成晶圓座標（光罩誤差除以 4），對 16 ms 的滑動窗口計算 MA 與 MSD，沿掃描方向畫成曲線，再與曝光後的套刻與 CD 量測對應，確認兩者的空間分佈一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log reticle- and wafer-stage position errors from the servo at tens of kHz, convert them to wafer coordinates (reticle error divided by 4), compute MA and MSD over a sliding 16 ms window, plot them along the scan direction and correlate with post-exposure overlay and CD measurements to confirm matching spatial patterns. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：掃描方向的加速段若未完全穩定就進入曝光，場的起始端會留下系統性的 MA 偏移與較高的 MSD，表現為每個場上緣的套刻偏差與線寬粗糙，而靜態定位測試完全看不出來。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If exposure starts before the acceleration phase has fully settled, the leading edge of every field carries a systematic MA offset and elevated MSD, seen as overlay deviation and rougher linewidth along one field edge, something a static positioning test never reveals.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從伺服系統以取樣率數十 kHz 記錄光罩台與晶圓台的位置誤差，先換算成晶圓座標（光罩誤差除以 4），對 16 ms 的滑動窗口計算 MA 與 MSD，沿掃描方向畫成曲線，再與曝光後的套刻與 CD 量測對應，確認兩者的空間分佈一致。
knowledge.textEn: Log reticle- and wafer-stage position errors from the servo at tens of kHz, convert them to wafer coordinates (reticle error divided by 4), compute MA and MSD over a sliding 16 ms window, plot them along the scan direction and correlate with post-exposure overlay and CD measurements to confirm matching spatial patterns.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「步進掃描的同步誤差定義」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan"?
options: 從伺服系統以取樣率數十 kHz 記錄光罩台與晶圓台的位置誤差，先換算成晶圓座標（光罩誤差除以 4），對 16 ms 的滑動窗口計算 MA 與 MSD，沿掃描方向畫成曲線，再與曝光後的套刻與 CD 量測對應，確認兩者的空間分佈一致。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
隔振器把所有頻率的振動都衰減。
optionsEn: Log reticle- and wafer-stage position errors from the servo at tens of kHz, convert them to wafer coordinates (reticle error divided by 4), compute MA and MSD over a sliding 16 ms window, plot them along the scan direction and correlate with post-exposure overlay and CD measurements to confirm matching spatial patterns.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Isolators attenuate vibration at every frequency.
quiz.explanation: 從伺服系統以取樣率數十 kHz 記錄光罩台與晶圓台的位置誤差，先換算成晶圓座標（光罩誤差除以 4），對 16 ms 的滑動窗口計算 MA 與 MSD，沿掃描方向畫成曲線，再與曝光後的套刻與 CD 量測對應，確認兩者的空間分佈一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log reticle- and wafer-stage position errors from the servo at tens of kHz, convert them to wafer coordinates (reticle error divided by 4), compute MA and MSD over a sliding 16 ms window, plot them along the scan direction and correlate with post-exposure overlay and CD measurements to confirm matching spatial patterns. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 步進掃描的同步誤差定義：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 掃描方向的加速段若未完全穩定就進入曝光，場的起始端會留下系統性的 MA 偏移與較高的 MSD，表現為每個場上緣的套刻偏差與線寬粗糙，而靜態定位測試完全看不出來。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If exposure starts before the acceleration phase has fully settled, the leading edge of every field carries a systematic MA offset and elevated MSD, seen as overlay deviation and rougher linewidth along one field edge, something a static positioning test never reveals. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此規格不是單一的定位精度，而是對掃描時間窗平均後的 MA 與 MSD。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The specification is therefore not a single positioning accuracy but MA and MSD averaged over the scan time window.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「晶圓台的靜態定位精度就等於套刻精度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The static positioning accuracy of the stage equals the overlay accuracy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: Abbe 原理與計量框架：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The Abbe principle and the metrology frame: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「計量框架與 Abbe 偏置」如何決定微影晶圓台精密定位的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Metrology frame and Abbe offset” determines the key performance of “Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Abbe 原理要求量測軸與被量測點共線，否則載台的微小旋轉會乘上偏置距離變成位置誤差。晶圓表面與干涉儀光束或編碼器讀頭之間總有數毫米的垂直偏置，所以晶圓台必須同時量測六個自由度，用俯仰與偏擺角把 Abbe 誤差算回去。所有量測都參照一個由 Zerodur 或碳化矽製成、與機架隔振的計量框架，投影鏡頭與感測器固定其上，使位置量測的參考零點與影像位置共用同一剛體。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「計量框架與 Abbe 偏置」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Abbe principle demands that the measurement axis pass through the point of interest, otherwise a tiny stage rotation multiplied by the offset distance becomes a position error. There is always a vertical offset of several millimetres between the wafer surface and the interferometer beams or encoder heads, so the wafer stage must be measured in all six degrees of freedom and the pitch and yaw angles used to compute the Abbe error back out. Every measurement refers to a metrology frame made of Zerodur or silicon carbide and isolated from the base frame; the projection lens and sensors are mounted on it so the position reference and the image share one rigid body. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Metrology frame and Abbe offset”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Abbe 誤差 = 偏置 × 旋轉角：偏置 5 mm、載台俯仰 0.2 µrad 時誤差 = 5×10⁻³×0.2×10⁻⁶ = 1 nm；若角度量測解析度為 0.05 µrad，殘餘 Abbe 誤差可壓到 0.25 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Abbe error = offset × rotation: with a 5 mm offset and 0.2 µrad of stage pitch the error is 5×10⁻³×0.2×10⁻⁶ = 1 nm; with an angular measurement resolution of 0.05 µrad the residual Abbe error falls to 0.25 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要載台導軌夠直，旋轉誤差就可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With straight enough guideways, rotation errors can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「計量框架與 Abbe 偏置」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Metrology frame and Abbe offset”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: The Abbe principle demands that the measurement axis pass through the point of interest, otherwise a tiny stage rotation multiplied by the offset distance becomes a position error. There is always a vertical offset of several millimetres between the wafer surface and the interferometer beams or encoder heads, so the wafer stage must be measured in all six degrees of freedom and the pitch and yaw angles used to compute the Abbe error back out.

steps.title: Abbe 原理與計量框架：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The Abbe principle and the metrology frame: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「計量框架與 Abbe 偏置」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Metrology frame and Abbe offset” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Abbe 誤差 = 偏置 × 旋轉角：偏置 5 mm、載台俯仰 0.2 µrad 時誤差 = 5×10⁻³×0.2×10⁻⁶ = 1 nm；若角度量測解析度為 0.05 µrad，殘餘 Abbe 誤差可壓到 0.25 nm。計量框架若在 1 m 跨距上有 10 nm 的熱變形，對應 0.01 µrad 的參考傾斜，在 300 mm 晶圓邊緣造成 1.5 nm 的位置偏差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Abbe error = offset × rotation: with a 5 mm offset and 0.2 µrad of stage pitch the error is 5×10⁻³×0.2×10⁻⁶ = 1 nm; with an angular measurement resolution of 0.05 µrad the residual Abbe error falls to 0.25 nm. A thermal deformation of 10 nm over a 1 m span of the metrology frame equals a 0.01 µrad reference tilt, which displaces positions by 1.5 nm at the edge of a 300 mm wafer. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：刻意讓載台在固定 XY 位置上做已知的俯仰與偏擺微動，記錄 XY 讀值的變化，擬合出實際的 Abbe 偏置距離並與機械設計值比較；再以放在晶圓位置的參考標記對準量測，確認補償後的殘差小於預算值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Command known small pitch and yaw motions at a fixed XY position, record the resulting XY readings, fit the actual Abbe offset distance and compare it with the mechanical design value; then measure alignment on a reference mark at wafer height to confirm that the compensated residual stays below budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

A thermal deformation of 10 nm over a 1 m span of the metrology frame equals a 0.01 µrad reference tilt, which displaces positions by 1.5 nm at the edge of a 300 mm wafer.

steps.title: Abbe 原理與計量框架：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: The Abbe principle and the metrology frame: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「計量框架與 Abbe 偏置」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Metrology frame and Abbe offset” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 刻意讓載台在固定 XY 位置上做已知的俯仰與偏擺微動，記錄 XY 讀值的變化，擬合出實際的 Abbe 偏置距離並與機械設計值比較；再以放在晶圓位置的參考標記對準量測，確認補償後的殘差小於預算值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Command known small pitch and yaw motions at a fixed XY position, record the resulting XY readings, fit the actual Abbe offset distance and compare it with the mechanical design value; then measure alignment on a reference mark at wafer height to confirm that the compensated residual stays below budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：晶圓夾盤更換後晶圓表面高度改變 0.5 mm，若軟體仍用舊的 Abbe 偏置，每 1 µrad 的載台旋轉就多出 0.5 nm 的未補償誤差，套刻在場與場之間出現與旋轉相關的系統性圖案。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: After a chuck exchange raises the wafer surface by 0.5 mm, software still using the old Abbe offset leaves 0.5 nm of uncompensated error per microradian of stage rotation, and overlay shows a rotation-correlated systematic pattern from field to field.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 刻意讓載台在固定 XY 位置上做已知的俯仰與偏擺微動，記錄 XY 讀值的變化，擬合出實際的 Abbe 偏置距離並與機械設計值比較；再以放在晶圓位置的參考標記對準量測，確認補償後的殘差小於預算值。
knowledge.textEn: Command known small pitch and yaw motions at a fixed XY position, record the resulting XY readings, fit the actual Abbe offset distance and compare it with the mechanical design value; then measure alignment on a reference mark at wafer height to confirm that the compensated residual stays below budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 晶圓夾盤更換後晶圓表面高度改變 0.5 mm，若軟體仍用舊的 Abbe 偏置，每 1 µrad 的載台旋轉就多出 0.5 nm 的未補償誤差，套刻在場與場之間出現與旋轉相關的系統性圖案。
knowledge.textEn: After a chuck exchange raises the wafer surface by 0.5 mm, software still using the old Abbe offset leaves 0.5 nm of uncompensated error per microradian of stage rotation, and overlay shows a rotation-correlated systematic pattern from field to field.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「Abbe 原理與計量框架」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The Abbe principle and the metrology frame" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
致動器力量越大，定位就越精準。
晶圓夾盤更換後晶圓表面高度改變 0.5 mm，若軟體仍用舊的 Abbe 偏置，每 1 µrad 的載台旋轉就多出 0.5 nm 的未補償誤差，套刻在場與場之間出現與旋轉相關的系統性圖案。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Stronger actuators give more precise positioning.

After a chuck exchange raises the wafer surface by 0.5 mm, software still using the old Abbe offset leaves 0.5 nm of uncompensated error per microradian of stage rotation, and overlay shows a rotation-correlated systematic pattern from field to field.
quiz.explanation: 晶圓夾盤更換後晶圓表面高度改變 0.5 mm，若軟體仍用舊的 Abbe 偏置，每 1 µrad 的載台旋轉就多出 0.5 nm 的未補償誤差，套刻在場與場之間出現與旋轉相關的系統性圖案。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: After a chuck exchange raises the wafer surface by 0.5 mm, software still using the old Abbe offset leaves 0.5 nm of uncompensated error per microradian of stage rotation, and overlay shows a rotation-correlated systematic pattern from field to field. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
